case.summary: Case HHG-017 was triggered by a risk score of 0.57 on online transaction 3450629 ($100.09) using card C04570-K1. Although the transaction utilized an anonymous proxy, the device profile had been successfully used twice before by this cardholder. The case-memory model evaluated the transaction at a very low fraud probability of 0.02, and the final assessed probability is 0.04. Consequently, the transaction was determined to be legitimate, and the case was closed with no action taken.
